profile.ja: 対魔忍。昔からヒーローに憧れて修業に励むが、彼女の能力は普通には開花しないと言われ、苦心していた。そんなある日の任務実習中、敵に襲われて仲間が危機に陥る。麦は自身も重傷を負いながら、仲間を救うため、全身の対魔粒子を高め捨て身で敵に突っ込む。敵は飛んで火に入る夏の虫とばかりに彼女をひねり潰そうとしたが、限界まで高めた彼女の対魔粒子は全身を覆う衣と化し、身体能力は飛躍的に向上。麦は敵を一網打尽にした。彼女の忍法は対魔法衣といい、対魔粒子を衣のようなスーツと化して纏い、攻撃、防御、スピードなどを驚異的に上げる術だったのだ。この事件をきっかけに彼女は対魔忍として開花。卒業後も各地で大活躍している。だが、彼女の能力はエネルギーの消費が激しく３０分が限界で、休憩しないと再度変身できない。
profile.en: Shijima Mugi is a Taimanin who has long idolized heroes and trained tirelessly, though she was told her abilities would never fully blossom. During a mission training exercise, her team was ambushed and a comrade was in danger. Despite sustaining serious injuries herself, Mugi amplified all her Taimanin particles and threw herself at the enemy in a self-sacrificial charge. The foes tried to crush her like a summer insect caught in flame, but the maximally heightened particles formed a protective garment around her, dramatically boosting her physical abilities. She swept the enemies away. Her ninjutsu, called "Taimanin Armor," transforms Taimanin particles into a suit that dramatically enhances attack, defense, and speed. This incident triggered her full emergence as a Taimanin. After graduating, she has been active across the land. However, her ability consumes massive energy and lasts only thirty minutes; without a break she cannot transform again.

text.ja: 正義の対魔忍、詩嶋麦！　ただいま参上！　私が来たからには、もう大丈夫よ――さぁ、悪党ども！　正義の鉄槌、お見舞いしてやるわ！
text.en: I'm Shijima Mugi, the Taimanin of justice! I'm here to save the day - don't worry, everything's gonna be alright! Now, you villains, get ready for a taste of justice!

text.ja: このスーツ、そしてこの力――どう？　まさしく正義のヒーロー、って感じがするでしょ？
text.en: What do you think of this suit and my powers? Doesn't it feel like I'm a true hero of justice?

text.ja: 昔は私も、あんまり力が伸びなかったのよね。でも、ある事件がきっかけで、大きく成長できたの――学生のみんなは、まだまだこれからよ！
text.en: I used to be pretty weak, but something changed after a certain incident, and I was able to grow a lot - all the students still have a long way to go, though!

text.ja: あ、あれは――ごめん、ちょっと行ってくるわ！　どうしたの、子供たち！　困ったことがあったら、いつでも私を呼んでちょうだい！
text.en: Oh, what's going on? Sorry, I'll be right back! What's wrong, kids? If you're in trouble, don't hesitate to call me!

text.ja: ふぅ……あ、恥ずかしいとこ見られたわね。私の力って、実は30分くらいしか持たなくて……もっと長持ちするよう、いまも修行中なの
text.en: Ugh... I'm so embarrassed - my powers only last about 30 minutes, and I'm still training to make them last longer...

text.ja: 今日はオフよ。しっかり休まないと、正義の執行だって難しいからね
text.en: Today's my day off, so I'm gonna take it easy - if I don't rest, I won't be able to carry out justice properly!

text.ja: 対魔法衣の力で、あらゆる身体能力が成長しているの――効果があるうちなら、どんな相手にも負けないわ！
text.en: With the power of my Taimanin Armor, all my physical abilities are enhanced - as long as the effect lasts, I won't lose to anyone!

text.ja: うっ、うぅ……長引いちゃうと、さすがにね……でもそれだけ、修行の余地があるってことだもん！　もっともっと、頑張らないと！
text.en: Ugh, it's so frustrating when it takes too long... but that just means I have more room for improvement - I've gotta keep pushing myself!

text.ja: 例え素顔を見られても、正義は絶対に揺るがない……！　でも、胸をジロジロみるなぁ……！
text.en: Even if my face is exposed, justice won't waver... but stop staring at my chest, okay?

text.ja: お、女の子にこんな格好をさせるなんて、とんでもない悪者だな！？
text.en: You're a terrible villain for putting a girl in a getup like this!

text.ja: うう……対魔法衣が破れちゃって力が出ない……こ、こんな時に攻撃されたら……
text.en: No... my Taimanin Armor's broken, and I've lost my powers... if I get attacked now...
